description: This Java source file defines the class MongoPersistenceOperationsSelectionProvider, which provides methods to select/deleting documents in a MongoDB EventSource persistence context based on entity IDs and namespaces. It interacts with MongoDB using BSON documents and is part of the persistence layer for event sourcing.

classes.name: MongoPersistenceOperationsSelectionProvider
classes.description: Final class providing selection operations for MongoDB EventSource persistence, including filtering by entity ID and namespace.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to instantiate MongoPersistenceOperationsSelectionProvider with given settings.

methods.name: selectEntity
methods.description: Returns a collection of selection objects for all occurrences of an entity ID in various collections.

methods.name: selectNamespace
methods.description: Returns a collection of selection objects for all occurrences of a namespace if supported.

methods.name: selectNamespaceByPid
methods.description: Creates a selection for a namespace based on the partition ID.

methods.name: filterByPidPrefix
methods.description: Constructs a BSON regex document to filter documents where the PID starts with a specific prefix for a namespace.

methods.name: selectEntityByPid
methods.description: Creates a selection object for an entity ID within a specified collection.

methods.name: filterByPid
methods.description: Creates a BSON document to filter documents by the entity's PID.
